acceptanceCriteria: Release source_quality executes the Contract-aware Rust gate whenever the strict release route binds a Contract and passes its receipt to run_repository_gates.py, with receipt artifacts uploaded.
Workspace version is exactly 0.2.89 and all required current release/version projections are consistent; v0.2.88 remains unchanged.
Reviewed PR hosted checks pass, including route, quality, Windows runtime, and v1 behavioral oracle, before merge.

After merge, the v0.2.89 tag is immutable and the provider Release plus all target artifacts, source-quality receipts, version-consistency, adopter installation, and upgrade acceptance evidence are bound to the merged commit and temporary roots are cleaned.
The Work Item is archived, finalized, closed, exact branch/worktree cleanup is verified, main is synchronized, and post-close documentation promotion check is current.
goal: Produce and publish v0.2.89 from a reviewed PR whose hosted release workflow executes the Contract-aware Rust gate and binds its receipt to repository gates, while preserving prior v0.2.88 failure evidence.
intent: Recover the failed v0.2.88 release path and publish a new immutable v0.2.89 release with strict Contract-aware source quality evidence.
outOfScope: Runtime production implementation; performance optimization implementation; changing historical WI-764/v0.2.88 evidence; deleting or reusing v0.2.88 tag; weakening or skipping repository gates; unrelated documentation or refactors; global Agent/MCP configuration

scenarioCoverage.expected: The release source_quality job evaluates the active Contract with the Rust gate and passes its receipt to the repository gate runner; missing binding fails closed.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: strict release route binds the Contract-aware Rust gate
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the release workflow on the reviewed v0.2.89 tag and inspect the source-quality and Contract-gate receipts and hosted job logs.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Cargo metadata, Cargo.lock, the reviewed merge commit, annotated v0.2.89 tag, release manifest, checksums, SBOMs, and provider Release all bind to the same source revision and version.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: reviewed source commit produces one immutable v0.2.89 identity
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run local version checks, merge only the reviewed PR, create the annotated v0.2.89 tag once, and validate hosted release identity and public assets.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The downloaded immutable v0.2.89 artifact passes version, manifest, root isolation, cleanup, and Runtime identity checks without using the workspace binary.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: release artifacts pass isolated adopter installation
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the public adopter acceptance harness against the provider Release asset and retain its isolation receipt and manifests.

scenarioCoverage.expected: An isolated adopter can upgrade from v0.2.87 to the downloaded v0.2.89 artifact while preserving governed history and proving cleanup and identity binding.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: v0.2.89 preserves the v0.2.87 to v0.2.89 upgrade boundary
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the public upgrade acceptance harness with immutable v0.2.87 and v0.2.89 artifacts and retain the receipt.

scope: .github/workflows/release.yml; Cargo.toml; Cargo.lock; current release/version documentation and tri-language parity entries required by the repository; WI-768 governance evidence and release/adopter acceptance evidence
